environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in us-east-1. The NLB performs TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the instance via nginx reverse proxy. No application-layer inspection is performed by the load balancer. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service with Python 3.11, SQLite database stored on local EBS volume at /data/app.db. API keys are distributed to internal consumers but the endpoint is internet-facing for remote office access.
